transform_function_lift_params: transform a function closing over Sonnet modules into init and apply pure functions
transform_with_state_network: transform a stateful network function to extract params and non-trainable state separately
create_tensor_variables_scope: create a context manager scope that forces tf.Variable to produce TensorVariable instances
track_tensor_variables: track all TensorVariable instances created or accessed within a context manager
without_state_wrapper: wrap a stateful transformed function to enforce that no non-trainable state is present
